title: Israeli strike kills at least two at Gaza seaport café, medics say
summary: An ⁠Israeli airstrike ​killed at least two Palestinians and wounded ​12 on Sunday at a Gaza café that was packed with people celebrating public holidays, ​health officials ‌said. There was no immediate ⁠Israeli comment. An October ceasefire, brokered by U.S. President Donald ‌Trump, has failed to halt Israeli attacks ⁠in Gaza.
